newsitem.title: USA: Lunar says densitometry payments to fall.
newsitem.headline: Lunar says densitometry payments to fall.

text.p: Lunar Corp said Tuesday the Health Care Financing Administration has lowered the 1997 fee reimbursement guidelines for bone densitometry.

It said Medicare reimbursement was $124 for the procedure, but until now it did not explicitly distinguish the two types -- peripheral (for measuring bones in the forearms and other sites) and axial (spine, hip bone measurement).
Under the new schedule, peripheral densitometry will drop to $37.57 from $124, while axial densitometry will drop to $121.16.
Lunar said it and Hologic Inc sell axial densitometers. It said Norland Medical Systems Inc focuses on peripheral densitometers.
